source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per battle, per unit, when **selected to shoot** in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), this unit may use this ability. Its ranged attacks then get +1 to **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for the rest of that phase.

To track it, place Ammo Runt tokens beside the unit and take them away when the ability is used.
